protocol.inputs: Existing native/prepared data, saved CodeBERT predictions, cached length features and source-fitted TF-IDF models only.
protocol.training: No training, checkpoint selection, threshold adjustment, CodeBERT inference or changes to data/evaluation members.
protocol.matching: Existing match_lengths: exact total lines, seed 42, labels 0/1, no replacement. New diagnostic subsets of the fixed independent cohorts; historical Motivation subsets unchanged.
protocol.project_identity: native project_url, strip trailing slash/.git, casefold; no inferred aliases; unknown URLs excluded only from project seen/unseen breakdowns
protocol.uncertainty: 1000 project-cluster bootstrap draws, percentile 95% intervals, seed 42; conditional on the fixed checkpoint/cohort
protocol.interpretation: Matching changes the evaluated population; associations and score correlations do not identify internal causal reliance. Native label disagreements do not establish which label is correct.

native_labels.interpretation: Different native labels for identical code are annotation/context disagreements, not automatically verified label errors.
